title.narrative: Capacities of youth stakeholders strengthened, knowledge generated and youth actions, networks and spaces supported to develop and implement youth-focused policies and programmes addressing multidimensional societal challenges faced by youth in South East Europe.

description.narrative: In the context of UNESCO’s work on Youth as Priority Group, this workplan intends to support youth-led action in follow-up to the recommendations of the 14th UNESCO Youth Forum. The 14th UNESCO Youth Forum, held on 27 and 28 October 2025, in Samarkand, focused on climate action and social impacts, particularly for young people. 145 youth from 135 countries issued a global call to action and a set of global and regional recommendations. Climate-action projects led by Forum participants were selected for support, becoming key outcomes of the Youth Forum and helping to generate concrete, on-the-ground impact. The Forum’s conclusions were then presented to Member States at the General Conference.
